title: Kissed by Claypot Flavors Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado Style Stir Fry
description: A light, peppery, and tender Peruvian dish made with beef strips cooked in a claypot with a flavorful sauce. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: beef strips (1 pound, thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality beef for best results.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate fresh ginger for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced or crushed garlic works best.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion for even cooking.

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.notes: Seed and dice the tomato for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: peanuts
ingredients.notes: Chopped or sliced peanuts work well.

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.notes: Use fresh or dried coriander for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium salt for a healthier option.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the scallions for garnish.

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a claypot over medium-high heat.
